settings.editor: SERVICES
You do not need to know which format you need before we talk. Start with the situation that feels closest to yours. From there, we can choose the level of depth, time and support that makes sense.
All formats are practical, communication-focused and built around real situations.
For teams & leaders
Build a shared language for communication, understand what different people need and recognise stress patterns earlier.
Training can focus on the whole team, on leadership communication or on deeper PCM skills.
PCM Core · Leadership · Advanced · Team development
For individuals
Bring one communication situation, recurring pattern or relationship dynamic that you would like to understand more clearly.
You can start without profiling, or go deeper with an official PCM personality profile and debrief.
Individual consultation · PCM Profile & debrief
Short practical format
A focused practical way to introduce a team or group to differences in communication without committing to a full training programme.
Useful for business clubs, conferences, team days and internal learning sessions.
Workshop · Practical · Adaptable to the group

I work with teachers, school leaders and educational teams on communication, motivation, feedback and communication under pressure. PCM Leadership Training applies the same practical framework to this educational context.
WHAT CONNECTS ALL OF THESE
I work with Process Communication Model® (PCM), a practical framework for understanding differences in perception, motivation, communication and stress.
You do not need to learn the whole model to benefit from it. Sometimes one conversation is enough to see a situation differently. Sometimes a team needs a shared language and more practice.
The format changes. The goal stays the same: more clarity, less unnecessary tension and more ways to reach different people.
Tell me briefly what is happening. We can start there and decide what kind of support makes sense.
